title: Why your brain treats tax refunds like free money
description:
Mental accounting makes us waste tax refunds and bonuses on things we'd never buy with regular salary. Learn how to treat every dollar the same and build long-term wealth.

Free 7-day Money Reset checklist + calculators: https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/

Educational content, not financial advice. Narration and visuals are AI-assisted.
